text:
maya: Quick sync — we need to finalize scope for the Tenant X roadmap ask (customer-driven): they want version pinning + a canary/A-B experiment before GA. Need acceptance criteria, rollback rules, and scope tradeoffs. Who can start a PRD section?

alex: I can start the PRD draft for rollout config. Key constraints: pin TTL, automatic expiration, fallback model variant, and rate limits for pinned tenants.

sam: SRE notes: define phased percents, circuit-breakers (error-rate/p95), and an emergency rollback API. Also need an ops runbook.

nate: ML metrics: p95 latency, error %, and quality regression via our eval set. Add embedding-similarity drift and hallucination checks (delta > 0.03 -> flag).

helen: From UX: show a clear toggle in the console for customers to opt into the canary and a banner indicating "experimental outputs". Also need a rollback notification path.

maya: Customer constraint: HIPAA tenant; they insist on pinning for at least 60 days and no outbound model telemetry from their VPC. Legal will need to sign off. Can we meet 60-day pin plus automated safety expirations?

alex: Yes but we should enforce a max pin TTL with opt-in extensions. Also we must prevent unlimited memory pinning causing capacity fragmentation. Proposal in config: pin_ttl_days default 30, max 90, tenant_override flag if legal approves.

alex: 
```yaml
rollout:
  phases:
    - pct: 1
      duration: 6h
    - pct: 10
      duration: 24h
  pin_ttl_days: 60
  pin_expiration_policy: auto-expire
  fallback: redwood-llm-small-v2-8q8
  rollback_policy:
    auto_on_error_rate_pct: 1.0
    auto_on_p95_ms: 250
  metrics:
    - p95_latency_ms: 120
    - error_rate_percent: 0.5
    - quality_regression_threshold: 0.02
```

sam: Add fast rollback command: `/rollout rollback --thread 1934567890 --to previous` and automation: if error_rate > 1% sustained for 15m -> auto-rollback with incident page. Also add CPU/GPU memory guardrails.

alex: Experiment design note: run A/B with Bayesian stopping. Target metric: customer API latency and a quality delta threshold (>=5% improvement). Minimum run: 48h at 10% traffic, then expand if posterior prob > 0.9.

maya: Acceptance criteria (draft):
- Tech: p95 latency delta vs baseline <= +15ms at 10% traffic; p99 < 250ms; error_rate < 0.5% for 48h.
- Quality: no regression on canonical eval set (quality_regression_threshold <= 0.02).
- Ops: SRE runbook completed with rollback automation and capacity plan.
- Legal: HIPAA sign-off for pin and telemetry constraints.
- Product: customer-visible opt-in flow and release notes.

nate: Edge cases: pinned tenants + long-context requests may blow GPU memory. Mitigation: limit max_seq_len=2048 for pinned model, fallback to smaller model with graceful degrade (503 + message). Also add token-limit enforcement at API layer.

helen: Customer comms: set expectations docs + dashboard toggle + option to opt-out of auto-updates. Provide a "what changed" diff for outputs after rollout.

maya: Action items: alex -> PRD rollout config draft; sam -> SRE runbook + automation playbook; legal -> confirm HIPAA pin allowance; nate -> add eval set & thresholds; helen -> UI copy and dashboard toggle mock. Review scheduled Tue 3pm PT.

alex: Ack. I'll put a WIP PRD under docs/prd/tenant-x-rollout.md and add the YAML config as an example.

deploy-bot: created ticket INF-4321: "Tenant X rollout runbook & PRD" and assigned to alex/sam/nate.

maya: Thanks team — keeping scope tight: if any blocker prevents meeting acceptance gates, we push to staged internal-only canary and loop the customer in.

sam: One last ops Q: do we allow tenant pins to block autoscaling decisions? My vote: no — pins should be honored on model selection but auto-scale still applies; we add quota safeguards.

alex: Agreed. Pins influence routing only, not hard capacity guarantees unless reserved Dedicated is purchased. We'll document this tradeoff in PRD.

maya: Perfect. That's enough to draft the PRD section. I'll synthesize notes after the review and attach to the roadmap epic.
